question: The terms Kumi-Kata, Shintai, Ukemi are associated with which sports?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Judo**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Judo**:-

 
 
• **Judo is a Japanese martial art that originated in the late 19th century.**
 
• It was developed by Jigoro Kano, who was a practitioner of Ju-jitsu, a traditional Japanese martial art.
 
• Ju-jitsu is a close-combat fighting system that originated in feudal Japan and was used by the samurai.
 
• Judo is based on the principles of Ju-jitsu but emphasizes throws, pins, and joint locks rather than strikes and kicks.
 
• Judo became an Olympic sport in 1964 and is now practiced worldwide.
 
• **The terms Kumi-Kata, Shintai, Ukemi are associated with Judo.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Polo

 
 
• Polo, game played on horseback between two teams of four players each of who uses mallets with long, flexible handles to drive a wooden ball down a grass field and between two goalposts.
 
• It is the oldest of equestrian sports.
 
• A game of Central Asian origin, polo was first played in Persia (Iran) at dates given from the 6th century BC to the 1st century AD.
 
 
 
• **Fencing**:-
 
 
• It is an intriguing sport with roots dating back centuries.
 
• **It originated as a form of sword fighting among European nobility, and over time, it has evolved into a competitive sport that tests physical fitness, speed, agility, and strategic thinking.**
 
 
 
• **Wrestling**:-
 
 
• Wrestling is a popular sport in India and has a rich history.
 
• **It is believed to have originated in the Indus Valley Civilization around 5000 years ago.**
 
• India has produced many legendary wrestlers in the past, including the likes of Dara Singh, Sushil Kumar, and Yogeshwar Dutt.
